1779.note_text: (1) An electronic device may be a complete ring instrument (for example: counter scale, electricity meter) or a part of a measuring instrument (for example: printer, indicator). (2) An electronic device can be a module in the sense that this term is used in OIML Publication B 3 “The OIML Certificate system for Measuring Instruments” [2].

1777.note_text: device employing electronic sub-assemblies and performing a specific function. Electronic devices are usually manufactured as   meas separate units and are capable of being tested independently
